newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico injects 3.619 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico injects 3.619 bln pesos.

text.p: Banco de Mexico injected 3.619 billion pesos in the secondary market on Thursday through one credit auctions, dealers said.
The auctions were offered as follows:
AMOUNT TERM MAX MIN AVERAGE BIDS BIDDERS
NOTE: Dealers said that the liquidity injection was meant to make up for a strong outflow of funds for tax payments, and other factors.
The tax payment is estimated at about 10.0 billion pesos due to strong sales in December that increased the amount of value-added tax to be paid.
